scope: Journey definitions and packet completeness do not establish device acceptance.

journeys.title: World and navigation
automationGaps: Normal Places and address controls; failed destination recovery

steps.action: Enter the shared reference domain from Places. Walk, look and touch its known interaction target.
steps.expected: The same world is visible, motion responds to touch and the target visibly reacts.

steps.action: Go To a second known destination, use Back, then attempt a deliberately unavailable destination.
steps.expected: Back returns to the reference world; failure is actionable and returning works without restarting.

journeys.cleanup: Return to the reference world; release every touch.

journeys.title: Account and domain authentication
journeys.entry: Normal account and domain login dialogs
automationGaps: Account/domain dialog semantics; protected credential handling

steps.action: Use the lab-owned automatic authentication challenge and then the normal manual Login entry.
steps.expected: Both useful dialogs appear; keyboard and confirmation work without revealing credentials in evidence.

steps.action: Cancel both dialogs; log out, restart and re-enter the protected reference domain.
steps.expected: Cancel leaves usable navigation; logout removes the authenticated state; restart/recovery has no stale dialog or credential reuse.

journeys.cleanup: Log out the lab account; stop recordings before entering any credential.

journeys.title: Avatar and People
automationGaps: Avatar selection, scale, wearables and peer connection UI

steps.action: Select the supplied avatar URL and a bookmark, change scale and add/remove the harmless reference wearable.
steps.expected: Visible avatar, size and wearable change as chosen; a bad URL gives a recoverable error.

steps.action: Meet the same controlled peer, open People and use the normal connect interaction.
steps.expected: Both sides see the intended avatar/peer and confirm the connection without losing existing People actions.

journeys.cleanup: Restore original avatar/scale/wearables; disconnect only the lab connection.

journeys.title: Native Create editor
automationGaps: Real property editor, tools, permissions and entity import

steps.action: Open Create, create a primitive, model and image, then list/select each.
steps.expected: Native useful controls remain touch-accessible; matching entities appear in the world and list.

steps.action: Edit position/name and type-specific properties, delete/undo, and exercise one voxel/tool operation.
steps.expected: Changes and undo are visibly applied to the intended entity; tools remain available.

steps.action: Import the harmless entity fixture and repeat a mutation without permission.
steps.expected: Import creates the expected content; denial is useful and makes no unauthorized mutation.

journeys.cleanup: Remove only created fixture entities and restore permissions.

journeys.title: Ten bundled emotes
automationGaps: All ten animation outcomes, loading and stop lifecycle

steps.action: For each of the ten bundled entries, observe loading/status, Play and avatar animation.
steps.expected: Each named entry produces its intended visible animation, not merely a selected button.

steps.action: Repeat Play/Stop/toggle, close/reopen, reload its script and restart the client.
steps.expected: Stopping returns the avatar to normal; there are no duplicate buttons, active orphan animation or handlers.

journeys.cleanup: Stop emotes and return the avatar to its normal pose.

journeys.title: World HTML, bridge and hardware MP4
journeys.entry: Running Scripts: shared ordinary web-reference script; visible world Web entity
automationGaps: Real final World texture pixels; provider capability; origin/epoch fences

steps.action: Load the repository web reference and touch its DOM counter, Unicode/number/invented-password/multiline fields; select/replace/composition-edit, scroll to marker4.
steps.expected: Real document changes and native IME selection/composition work; keyboard opening does not clear focus or move the toolbar over the document.

steps.action: Approve the explicit scriptURL through the normal consent flow and observe injection.
steps.expected: The world document reports the real injected script while preserving normal consent.

steps.action: Send the script echo, navigate to the second same-origin page, Back and Reload.
steps.expected: The actual ordinary Overte script roundtrip answers; navigation/history/loading behave correctly.

steps.action: Navigate to a second fixture server port and use ordinary DOM/IME/media there; then request echo and return.
steps.expected: Foreign documents keep useful input/media but echo times out; original-origin echo returns. No foreign Overte grant is created.

steps.action: Activate the world document file input and exercise close/source replacement while native input is pending. Test actual OS selection separately on the visible Tablet grant.
steps.expected: World scope does not gain a Tablet file-picker grant. Refusal remains honest; no stale input/bridge callback is delivered after replacing or closing this world owner.

steps.action: Press Play, observe several encoded red/green/blue cycles, moving square and burned-in video counters; seek4s, pause/resume. Record the visible video rectangle in its real product presentation.
steps.expected: The encoded MP4 pixels themselves move and change color, and the physical Phone output is audible. currentTime, DOM animation, server requests and renderer counters alone are insufficient.

steps.action: Play the looping tone; hide, close, replace, background/resume and stop the owning ordinary client script.
steps.expected: Audio silences when required and resumes only through intended user action; no stale input/bridge/frame callback survives replacement. The fixture does not cooperatively pause itself.

journeys.cleanup: Stop the diagnostic script; ensure its temporary Web entity/button disappear and audio is silent.

journeys.title: Tablet HTML and native media
journeys.entry: Normal tablet browser/app path, plus reference WEB TEST button
automationGaps: Native WebView overlay geometry, provider, packaged HTML and media

steps.action: Load the repository web reference and touch its DOM counter, Unicode/number/invented-password/multiline fields; select/replace/composition-edit, scroll to marker4.
steps.expected: Real document changes and native IME selection/composition work; keyboard opening does not clear focus or move the toolbar over the document.

steps.action: Send the script echo, navigate to the second same-origin page, Back and Reload.
steps.expected: The actual ordinary Overte script roundtrip answers; navigation/history/loading behave correctly.

steps.action: Navigate to a second fixture server port and use ordinary DOM/IME/media there; then request echo and return.
steps.expected: Foreign documents keep useful input/media but echo times out; original-origin echo returns. No foreign Overte grant is created.

steps.action: Choose a nonprivate reference image in the real OS provider, confirm preview, repeat and Cancel; background while the picker is open.
steps.expected: Actual chosen bytes preview; cancel is distinct; returning resumes the exact current request. Replacing/closing the owner while pending cannot rebind a late result.

steps.action: Press Play, observe several encoded red/green/blue cycles, moving square and burned-in video counters; seek4s, pause/resume. Record the visible video rectangle in its real product presentation.
steps.expected: The encoded MP4 pixels themselves move and change color, and the physical Phone output is audible. currentTime, DOM animation, server requests and renderer counters alone are insufficient.

steps.action: Play the looping tone; hide, close, replace, background/resume and stop the owning ordinary client script.
steps.expected: Audio silences when required and resumes only through intended user action; no stale input/bridge/frame callback survives replacement. The fixture does not cooperatively pause itself.

steps.action: Open one existing packaged HTML app through its normal entry and navigate its actual EventBridge action.
steps.expected: The packaged document loads through the approved application-resource mapping; its real script action works without arbitrary filesystem access.

steps.action: Use Back/Close around keyboard and provider operations, including a provider lacking bridge capability if available.
steps.expected: The48px toolbar/clipping remain correct; the document remains usable with an actionable bridge warning; unavailable bridge is explicitly blocked, never treated as a pass.

journeys.cleanup: Close the page; cancel any pending picker; stop only the reference script.

journeys.title: Graphics controls and world effects
automationGaps: Visible effect comparison and complete graphics policy

steps.action: Open Graphics and record the default safe Phone budget in the identical effects world.
steps.expected: The normal entry exists; no VR/controller controls appear; safe resolution/fps limits remain useful.

steps.action: Individually toggle lights, haze, procedural materials and mirrors; inspect the same known world content.
steps.expected: Each corresponding visible effect actually changes; mirror reflects the moving avatar, lights illuminate and haze/materials visibly differ.

steps.action: Restart, confirm chosen settings persist, then restore the defaults.
steps.expected: Choices persist and restored defaults return without silently enabling expensive effects.

journeys.cleanup: Restore saved graphics choices and confirm the world remains usable.

journeys.title: Voice, live echo and bounded recorded preview
automationGaps: Local preview/native routes; real audible live echo

steps.action: Exchange fresh spoken challenges with the same owned peer; mute/unmute both sides.
steps.expected: Each physical endpoint hears the intended opposite speaker; mute negative controls stay silent.

steps.action: Exercise microphone denial/recovery and the available speaker/headset route.
steps.expected: Denied permission has a useful recovery path; restored permission and selected route produce the intended physical audio.

steps.action: Enable live echo, speak, disable; start the three-second recorded preview and wait through capture/replay.
steps.expected: Live echo remains immediate; recorded preview has visible native-driven recording/replay status and actual bounded audible replay.

steps.action: Cancel during recording and playback, background/resume and close.
steps.expected: Capture/playback stop promptly; no stale preview or orphan microphone survives; normal voice can resume.

journeys.cleanup: Disable live echo/preview, restore route/mute and leave the test call.

journeys.title: Normal Chat and persistent history
automationGaps: Actual message protocol, peer receive and persistence

steps.action: Open Chat, enter harmless Unicode text using the Phone keyboard and exchange messages with the same owned peer.
steps.expected: The peer receives exactly one message and its reply is shown; send does not move the avatar or lose input.

steps.action: Close/reopen, restart, exercise history/settings and flood only a bounded lab sample.
steps.expected: Expected bounded history/settings persist; long/invalid inputs have useful outcomes without duplicate handlers.

journeys.cleanup: Clear only lab history if the product permits; restore settings.

journeys.title: Capture, preview and native export

steps.action: Capture still, animated and360/cubemap samples of the shared reference world; inspect previews.
steps.expected: The still depicts the actual world, GIF frames move and360/cubemap orientation/content is correct; preview can be dismissed.

steps.action: Save through the actual Android storage route and open the saved result from an independent normal app.
steps.expected: Save reports success only after complete publication; external image/GIF opens with intended contents, not merely a queued write.

steps.action: Share through the system chooser, choose a harmless test receiver; repeat and Cancel.
steps.expected: System handoff uses an OS content URI with narrow read access, never file://; completed and cancelled are distinct. Receiver persistence is not assumed.

steps.action: Exercise invalid/error storage, Cancel capture/export, and close/background while a chooser is pending.
steps.expected: Useful errors/cancel remain visible; a stale callback cannot complete a newer ticket; successful originals remain available.

steps.action: Exercise the existing permitted upload/audience action and its permission-denied case.
steps.expected: Actual intended upload/audience result occurs, or a useful honest denial; no fictitious upload is reported.

journeys.cleanup: Cancel active requests; remove only copies deliberately saved/uploaded for this fixture.

journeys.title: Scripts and preserved companions
automationGaps: OS folder selection; actual V8 results and relative include

steps.action: Load the harmless ordinary URL script and local script through the real native provider.
steps.expected: Concrete expected world/tablet result appears; list/running status matches actual execution.

steps.action: Choose the supplied folder with main.js and nested included/data files, review and explicitly select its main file.
steps.expected: Relative names/hierarchy are preserved; only the chosen main executes, and its actual companion-dependent result appears.

steps.action: Restart/stop/manage it; Cancel provider selection, deny/fail provider access and background while pending.
steps.expected: No duplicate or orphan script remains; cancellation/error is useful and late results cannot replace the current selection.

steps.action: Select folders exceeding file/byte/entry/depth limits and a duplicate/unsafe relative-name fixture if the provider can represent it.
steps.expected: The whole invalid selection is rejected visibly, with no truncated partial import. Ordinary JavaScript results do not imply WASM/JIT parity.

journeys.cleanup: Stop only fixture scripts and remove their temporary entities/buttons.

journeys.title: Assets, model companions and mutations
automationGaps: Live asset mapping/batch; rendered glTF/OBJ textures

steps.action: Browse the shared read-only assets and rez the same allowed model/image.
steps.expected: Normal browsing and touch controls work; expected model/image is visibly rendered; unauthorized mutation is denied.

steps.action: Choose the model folder; upload glTF plus external bin/textures, then OBJ plus nested MTL/textures, explicitly selecting each main.
steps.expected: Companions are preserved/published before the main mapping; visible geometry and distinct texture/material regions match the fixture, not just transferred hashes.

steps.action: Rename/delete a lab mapping and exercise the existing baking action with permitted and denied accounts.
steps.expected: Actual mapping/result changes are visible or a useful honest permission/bake limitation is recorded.

steps.action: Cancel or fail midway through provider copy and companion upload; repeat background/resume and duplicate names.
steps.expected: No primary mapping appears after partial failure; copies remain useful for the successful selection; unrelated originals/mappings are untouched.

journeys.cleanup: Delete only created lab mappings/entities; retain successful input copies until scripts/uploads no longer need them.

journeys.title: Lifecycle, input and accessibility

steps.action: Use touch and hardware/IME keyboard to open apps, move, select/edit and Back/Close; inspect accessibility controls.
steps.expected: Visible controls are reachable/labelled; no VR controls, stuck touch, accidental world motion or hidden overlay remains.

steps.action: Repeat background/resume while typing/composing, playing web tone, selecting a file and exporting a snapshot.
steps.expected: Correct current operations recover or cancel; orphan audio stops; the exact old owner cannot receive a new owner result.

steps.action: Replace Web source rapidly, close/reopen apps, restart and re-enter the reference world.
steps.expected: No stale frames, bridge messages, keyboard text, duplicate script handlers or native view survives; normal controls remain usable.

journeys.cleanup: Release all inputs, stop only test scripts/audio and return to a known usable state.
